system.effect: Grants the 'Heavy Munitions' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Heavy Munitions
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Roll 3 or more Action dice and spend 1 Use. Requires a ranged Source you can use.

Target. One creature within the Source's Range, against Fortitude. The roll maximum is Grace + Ballistics, as for Basic Ranged Attack.

Effect. On success, deal 2 Physical Damage of a type appropriate to the Source.

Surges. 1 Surge: deal +1 Damage. 2 Surges: push the target 1 unit directly away from you.
